name: ref
description: Specify the source (or direct string) of the environment variable value.
info: This can be a path to a local file or a 1Password path (e.g. op://vault/[section]/item).
Alternatively this can be the raw value of the target environment variable(s).

name: format
description: Specify the format of the source (e.g. JSON, YAML, TXT, String).
info: This reference supports any of the following options:
- TXT: any text file, including a 1Password entry containing the value
- String: (select if the Source Reference is the raw value of the target variable(s)

name: key
description: Configure key to start looking for the variable value (if format is JSON / YAML).
info: TerraUtils needs the key that holds the value for the environment variable (e.g. {api_key: {VALUE}}).
If the value is in a nested Hash, the subdivisions based on directory structure scope can be specified in the next step
- A 'nil' value can be used for this key if said subdivision(s) start from the root of the entry (e.g. {env: {VALUE}})

name: config_subdivisions
description: Select the subdivisions of the config based on the project directory scope.
info: If the environment variable value is nested inside the value source config, TerraUtils can retrieve it as long as the parent
elements follow a naming convention that can be resolved with the configured directory structure.
